summary: Backend-only verification of the 2026-09-03 core-flow round (Root 2 grounding, Root 3 escalation broadening, Root 4 tier-gated edit paths + upgrade offer). Ran all four new unit/E2E test files provided by main agent (24 unit + 2 live E2E = 26) plus a fresh live-verification suite I authored (10 additional live checks against the preview backend covering the explicit acceptance criteria: greeting-prefixed edit classifier tier, plain-greeting casual regression, free-tier honest upgrade offer for 3 different edit verbs, pro/founder tier never gated, and the FINAL GATE founder-repro 3x in a row). Also re-ran the 4 most-adjacent regression suites (business_owner_gates, business_owner_voice, mode_auto_escalation_2026_09_02, no_edit_deadend_guard_2026_09_02 = 38 tests). All 74 total tests PASS. The exact 3x founder-repro (greeting -> 'update my opening hours' -> 'yes please') no longer reproduces the fabricated-content-claim + orphan-confirm + 'nothing pending' dead end. Free-tier account correctly receives an honest 'want me to set up that upgrade?' offer instead of a silent switch or dead end; founder/admin tier is never gated.
action_items: OUT-OF-SCOPE (known + accepted, tracked in ROADMAP.md): after the free-tier upgrade-offer message, replying 'yes please' currently falls to the generic NO_PENDING_FIX_MESSAGE. The user's stated 'want me to set up that upgrade?' offer has no backing pending object, so the confirmation reply reads as a dead end. Not blocking this round but worth a follow-up: pair the upgrade offer with a real 'pending upgrade intent' object so 'yes please' can route to a real upgrade CTA.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/chat.py is 4,467 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline. It houses /send, /stream, classify-intent, plus ~4 duplicated wiring blocks for the Root 2 grounding + Root 4 upgrade-offer short-circuit at ~L629/L862/L2589/L3488. Duplicated across /send vs /stream doubles the surface for future drift. Recommend extracting an internal `apply_guards_and_gates(reply, ctx, tier, mode, has_pro)` helper both paths call.

services/mode_routing.py: needs_edit_upgrade_offer defaults account_has_pro=True (backward-compat), which is safe today but a footgun if a new caller forgets to pass it — the free-tier user would be silently un-gated. Consider making it a required kwarg (or a positional).

services/ora_chat/grounding_check.py: extract_line_content_claims currently regex-matches only quoted content around `line N`. A model that writes 'line 15: Open 9-5' without quotes will slip through the fabricated-content guard. Consider a second pattern for unquoted line-value pairs.

test_edit_tier_path_2026_09_03.py mutates os.environ in-process — the autouse fixture restores it correctly, but edit_tier_mode() reads env at each call, so it's fine. Just noting the pattern for future maintainers.

rca of the issue: Root cause of the original 3x founder repro: (1) the model on the tool-less casual path invented specific line/content claims because the escalation classifier's _AGENTIC_VERBS didn't cover plain-English content-edit verbs (change/update/correct/…) especially after a greeting prefix, so 'update my opening hours' fell to the casual tier which has no read_repo_file tool; (2) the reply's fabricated 'Would you like me to update this change?' asked for confirmation, but no aurem-handoff fence was ever produced (no real pending action registered), so the next 'yes please' turn correctly found nothing pending and produced NO_PENDING_FIX_MESSAGE — a UX dead end. Mitigation delivered this round: Root 2 grounding_check.contains_fabricated_content_claim wired into main /chat/send + /chat/stream compares any 'line N …' or '…at line N' content-value claim against the actually-retrieved context (system prompt + real tool_invocation results this turn); Root 3 broadened _AGENTIC_VERBS + first-token relaxation so greeting-prefixed edits classify as agentic and route to the tool-having pipeline; Root 4 introduced EDIT_TIER_MODE (default 'gated') + needs_edit_upgrade_offer so free-tier edit attempts get a real UPGRADE_OFFER_MESSAGE instead of a silent escalation or a 'nothing pending' dead end, while pro accounts remain silently escalated as before. Verified: the exact founder repro was run 3x live and NEVER fabricates and NEVER dead-ends.
